message.content: {"caption":"Three-stage diagram of a self-navigating agent’s experience pipeline, from collecting and retrieving experiences to using them in rollouts and policy training.","description":"The diagram is arranged in three numbered panels. In Experience Acquisition, an agent produces trajectories that are distilled into an Experience Pool of natural-language items; recall, rerank, and rewrite are shown as retrieval steps. In Experience-mixed Rollout, a query feeds experience-free rollouts labeled “null” and experience-guided rollouts labeled “exp”; each proceeds through a trajectory and an A<0 or A>0 outcome, marked with red unhappy faces and crosses or green happy faces and check marks. In Experience Incorporation, Experience Stripping shows query results with null or exp entries alongside trajectories and A<0 or A>0 outcomes. The lower panel shows training samples contributing to a policy model, with the condition “If exp & A>0” and the note “clip higher!”","figure_type":"diagram","chart_values":[]}
